# Allowed permissions for EVLauncher.
# Any uses-permission in a manifest NOT listed here FAILS the CI.
# Why: this app replaces the home screen. It runs on every boot, sees every installed
# package, and is the first thing the driver touches. Every new permission widens that
# surface and must be reviewed here.
#
# One line = one full permission name. '#' = comment.

# --- App drawer ---
# Required on API 30+ to enumerate launchable apps. Without it the drawer is empty.
android.permission.QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES

# --- System-info page ---
# Read-only: active connection type and Wi-Fi link speed for the second carousel page.
# Neither permission opens a socket, and neither exposes SSID/BSSID/MAC (never queried).
android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
android.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE

# --- User-initiated EVSuite release checks ---
# Used only when the EVSuite screen checks GitHub or downloads a user-confirmed APK.
# There is no background check, self-update, silent installer, or remote-control path.
android.permission.INTERNET

# --- Vehicle page (carousel page 3) ---
# READ ONLY. Neither permission permits a vehicle write, and the app calls no setter: every
# value goes through EVHardware's telemetry reader, which exposes getters only.
# CAR_ENERGY       — standard AAOS range remaining and charge-port-connected reads.
# CAR_VENDOR_EXTENSION — the vendor property space cannot be read at all without it; it
#                    carries the SWI68 fallbacks for state of charge and range.
# Justification and the reasoning for what was NOT added: docs/CR-010-vehicle-page.md.
android.car.permission.CAR_ENERGY
android.car.permission.CAR_VENDOR_EXTENSION

# --- Deliberately NOT allowed ---
# CAR_SPEED, CAR_EXTERIOR_ENVIRONMENT, CONTROL_CAR_CLIMATE — held by EVChargePilot, not here.
# The vehicle page shows no speed, no outside temperature and no HVAC state, and the app that
# owns the home screen holds no permission whose name contains CONTROL.
# Any android.car.permission.* granting a write, and sharedUserId: never.
# Installation always remains user-mediated by Android's package installer.
